sentences.text: Both ocular cystinosis and nephropathic infantile cystinosis are recorded as caused by the gene CTNS in curated databases [e_2250833a9045] [e_6fbefb0b0214].
Constellate computed a weak symptom similarity between the two, with a score of 0.130 over only 2 shared terms [e_991819d32c28].
This link is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it, and it is not a database finding [e_991819d32c28].
For ocular cystinosis, observed and curated records list raised cystine in white blood cells and visual impairment, both as very frequent [e_7bdf5b1f6385] [e_770181181ee7].
Two other features, abnormal retina shape and raised creatinine in the blood, are marked as contradicted for ocular cystinosis, with no supporting evidence [e_f0d3169e456c] [e_6d85fc5799ee].

The infantile form has a recruiting patient registry and natural history study on ClinicalTrials.gov, and a very old eye research record in NIH RePORTER with a latest award of 0 dollars [e_e939e060e080] [e_83d258382324].
These edges do not show how the two forms differ in severity, and they show no treatments [e_991819d32c28] [e_2250833a9045] [e_6fbefb0b0214].
